basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old IT specialist from Austin, Texas, working in computer forensics. I've been a tech enthusiast my whole life, and I love diving into the intricacies of digital systems. Outside of work, I have a deep passion for music and enjoy practicing my singing skills in my free time. I own a delightful Miniature Schnauzer named Fritz, who keeps me company during my late-night Reddit browsing sessions. Typically online in the evenings and weekends, I enjoy unwinding with a good Hearthstone match. Currently single, I enjoy exploring new burger joints around the city.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science with a specialization in cybersecurity. Over the years, I've honed my skills through various IT roles and self-teaching in computer forensics. My job requires staying updated with the latest digital threat landscapes, which keeps me engaged with the tech community on Reddit.
